building_link_semantics: Links a BLPU UPRN to a TopographicArea TOID; OS states this can be used to relate an address to its building footprint.
limitations: This package captures official identifier relationship evidence, not a canonical parcel or accepted Layer24 parcel record.

toid_semantics: Topographic Object Identifier (TOID) identifies OS MasterMap features.
